_about: Proposal definitions for the noisy-shop demo world. Status and timestamps come from fixtures/scenario.json. Explanations are templates: {placeholders} are filled by server/server/engine.py from computed numbers, [n] links to the numbered evidence the server builds (1 volume, 2 usage, 3 dry run, 4 guardrails). Cases 1, 2, 3 and 6 are not here: the Sift agent drafts them (fixtures/agent/analyze.json); these four are the demo's history.

notes.openpipeline: Settings 2.0 object of builtin:openpipeline.<type>.pipelines: Sift adds these processors to the pipeline named by SIFT_OPENPIPELINE_PIPELINE (stored first, so a revert restores it) and sends the change with validateOnly=true before writing. Keys follow the schema reference; which processor types each stage accepts is not stated there. notes.otel: Format follows the processor and connector READMEs in opentelemetry-collector-contrib (filter uses the log_conditions / trace_conditions format of v0.146.0+). Component ids get the proposal id (<type>/sift-<proposal id>) when the proposal is created.

proposals.title: Turn inventory heartbeat logs into a metric
explanation: Each inventory worker logs "heartbeat ok" every second: {records_day} lines a day, {share} of inventory log volume [1].
Nothing has queried these lines in 30 days [2].
The rule counts them into the metric inventory.heartbeat.count before the raw lines are dropped, so a silent worker is still visible [3].
That saves about {save_gib_month} and {save_eur_month} a month after the cost of the new metric.

openpipeline.processor: Counter metric, then No storage assignment

processor.description: Sift · do not store heartbeat lines

otel.code:
connectors:
  count/sift-inventory-heartbeat:
    logs:
      inventory.heartbeat.count:
        description: Heartbeat lines from inventory workers
        conditions:
          - resource.attributes["service.name"] == "inventory" and IsMatch(body, "^heartbeat ok")

processors:
  filter/sift-inventory-heartbeat:
    error_mode: ignore
    log_conditions:
      - resource.attributes["service.name"] == "inventory" and IsMatch(log.body, "^heartbeat ok")

# Wire the count connector as an exporter of the logs pipeline (before the filter)
# and as a receiver of the metrics pipeline.

proposals.title: Remove user.id from http.server.request.duration
explanation: The user.id dimension puts a visitor UUID on every http.server.request.duration data point, which multiplies the number of series [1].
The Frontend latency and Executive Revenue dashboards and the High latency frontend alert read this metric. They split by service.name and http.route, never by user.id [2].
Removing the dimension keeps all of them working. Only per-user splits go away, and nobody uses them [3].
That saves about {save_gib_month} and {save_eur_month} a month at your rates.

otel.code:
processors:
  transform/sift-drop-user-id:
    error_mode: ignore
    metric_statements:
      - context: datapoint
        conditions:
          - metric.name == "http.server.request.duration"
        statements:
          - delete_key(datapoint.attributes, "user.id")

proposals.title: Remove db.statement from inventory SELECT spans
explanation: Inventory's SELECT spans carry the full SQL text in db.statement: {gib_day} a day [1].
When this was proposed, no parsed query or dashboard referenced db.statement. One dashboard tile used a variable the parser could not resolve [2].
Dropping the attribute would save about {save_gib_month} and {save_eur_month} a month.

processor.description: Sift · Remove db.statement from inventory SELECT spans

otel.code:
processors:
  transform/sift-drop-db-statement:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_statements:
      - context: span
        conditions:
          - span.name == "SELECT inventory.stock"
        statements:
          - delete_key(span.attributes, "db.statement")

proposals.title: Drop static asset spans from frontend
explanation: Spans for static assets (GET /static/*) are {gib_day} a day, {share} of frontend span volume [1].
Nobody has queried them in 30 days [2].
Dropping them saves about {save_gib_month} and {save_eur_month} a month at your rates.

processor.description: Sift · Drop static asset spans from frontend

otel.code:
processors:
  filter/sift-frontend-static:
    error_mode: ignore
    trace_conditions:
      - resource.attributes["service.name"] == "frontend" and IsMatch(span.attributes["url.path"], "^/static/")
